ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 55 / OppVR75] First Bill Date cannot be in the past while in/moving to Qualification, Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification. Note: 'First Bill Date' mapped to IM_Booked_Date__c. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
NOT(ISBLANK(IM_Booked_Date__c)),
IM_Booked_Date__c < TODAY(),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid First Bill Date. The First Bill Date cannot be in the past for active Opportunities.
